svg.title: Pl Icp Step 2
svg.desc: Plot, Step 5 of point-to-line ICP, apply transform and update, then iterate. The scan's original position, a faint blue curve between y equals 3 and 4.5, has been transformed down onto the red reference curve, whose points are at (1, 1), (3, 2) and (5, 1.5) with faint tangent lines through them. The aligned cyan scan, P sub aligned, has points near (0.5, 0.5), (2.5, 2) and (4.5, 1.6) that lie on those tangent lines but not on the red points. A note reads: points align to structure, not necessarily exact pairs.
